cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: No Tie Stands
cards.instruction: Turn every even outcome into a formal rematch with a new rule and a consequence for losing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. We split the bill exactly. Now toss for who apologises to the waiter.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Otherwise this dinner ends without a distinction.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then least enthusiastic enjoyment pays the tip. Rate yours carefully.

confusable: D214 prices requests generally; D211 is triggered by tied outcomes and formal rematches.
comparison: Shared bill and tip differ from competitive cake judging.
seedUse: Keep exact bill split but establish a plausible cost rather than an unexplained apology to waiter.
